source_review: No blocking defect found for orderly clean release/swap only. Not hardware authorization or release qualification.
verified_by_source_review: PicoMEM first-open binding and explicit no-media rejection also under CONFIG_FS_XMS; no boot USB binding.
Closing guard spans native sync, inode and buffer invalidation, and firmware release.
Non-PicoMEM init/open/release behavior preserved by conditional hooks.
Firmware rejects legacy geometry and unbound read/write; only clean release enables normal detach selection reset.
No-media and unsupported-sector-size media remain removable without poisoning the session.
Sticky kernel/firmware faults are not cleared by detach, release, late completion, or new mount callback.
PIO command admission sets INPROGRESS synchronously before completion polling.
Release requires mounted/ready USB, no busy transfer, and no fault; buffer ownership serialized by command core.
remaining_validation: Actual cache quiescence across native unmount, raw descriptors, subsequent sys_umount fsync, and replacement mount needs native/emulator evidence; host harness mocks cache invalidation.
Production firmware lifecycle/fault-injection tests and native code-generation/build checks are separate parent-owned gates.
No surprise-removal recovery or durable completion guarantee for assumed write-through devices.
The void native release/fsync interfaces can leave umount returning success on storage error; failure log and permanent no-rebind fence remain necessary.

firmware_harness_review.scope: Actual bridge source, USB/PIO mocked; adds precise output-phase disconnect injections to parent harness.
